name: Furniture_Bench_Round_Table_Assembly
description: A dataset and benchmark for assembling a round table from furniture parts, intended to evaluate perception and planning capabilities for structured assembly tasks. Measures model/robot ability to interpret parts, plan an assembly sequence, and execute or predict correct assembly steps. Useful for research in robot manipulation, instruction following, and multi-step task decomposition.
reputation: A niche, task-specific benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with modest adoption in the robotics/benchmarks community.
